workload.build: Production mock built via Vite JS API with source maps, outside normal app dist
workload.preparation: Reload each run; await first row and 1200ms settling

limitations: Three observations per build on one machine; no cross-platform or general FPS guarantee.
TaskDuration is Chromium main-thread busy time during the complete scenario, not input latency or CPU percentage.
Long tasks are >=50ms; frame intervals include scheduling/painting. They are separate observations.
CPU hotspot profiles were captured separately and include profiling overhead; do not compare their timings with non-profiled runs.
Synthetic metadata mock has 25ms list delay and cached-wave misses; it neither queries SQLite nor decodes 100k files.
This measures Chromium rendering, not native RSS, total WebView memory or Tauri/WebKit performance.
Profiler raw JSON and complete source maps remain temporary; checked-in report retains raw unprofiled repetitions and sampled hotspot summaries.
